definitions.explanation: Spending the night sleeping in a car, either as a way of travelling cheaply or out of necessity, as after a disaster.

examples.japanese: {車中泊|しゃちゅうはく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I slept overnight in the car.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{駅|えき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{車中泊|しゃちゅうはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people are sleeping in their cars at roadside rest stops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ら→入る：00494_hairu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{車中泊|しゃちゅうはく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、エコノミー⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→症候群：30368_shoukougun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: After a disaster, staying in your car night after night instead of going to a shelter carries a risk of deep-vein thrombosis.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車中泊|しゃちゅうはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sleep overnight in one's car
- {車中泊|しゃちゅうはく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: a road trip sleeping in the car
- {車中泊|しゃちゅうはく}⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: a place to sleep in one's car

CULTURAL NOTE:
Car-camping trips have become popular, often at {道|みち}の{駅|えき} (roadside rest stations), some of which ask visitors not to stay overnight. After large earthquakes, many evacuees sleep in their cars, and doctors warn of blood clots from sitting cramped for long periods.
